verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud documents stealth on by default in a hardened Chromium fork and residential proxies on by default across 195+ countries, with residential proxy traffic priced at $5/GB. That covers the core of the story directly. However, the evidence does not show how to pick a target country or region per session, and it does not describe what the stealth fingerprinting actually covers. Missing for 10: a documented way to choose the proxy country or region (geo-targeting), detail on what fingerprint protections stealth includes, and independent or hands-on confirmation that automations avoid bot blocking.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can enable stealth fingerprinting and residential or geo-targeted proxies so legitimate automations aren't blocked as bots

citations.quote: Every cloud browser session runs in a hardened Chromium fork with stealth enabled by default — no configuration needed.
Residential proxies are enabled by default across 195+ countries.
Managed Chromium with stealth protections and proxy support.
Cloud browsers, plus $5 / GB residential proxy.
